title.zh: MiniMax正式发布M3.1 Flash：每百万Token最低0.15美元，23日开源
title.en: MiniMax正式发布M3.1 Flash：每百万Token最低0.15美元，23日开源

current_state.zh: MiniMax officially released M3.1 Flash, confirming it was the anonymous 'Space Bunny' model, publishing benchmarks (62.2% Automation-Bench, 73.7% DeepSWE, 91.0% BabyVision), setting API pricing at $0.15 per million input tokens and $0.60 output, and planning to open the weights on October 23.
